incident.claim_qualification: Literal scored-once execution did not hold for the duplicated fixed-arm prefixes. Retained deterministic records are reproducibility-checked; inferential findings must disclose this operational deviation. Measured timing under accidental contention cannot be treated as an isolated-device latency benchmark.
incident.compute_bound_definition: 8 duplicate workers: four observed at 1263 s and four at 407 s, plus one minute each allowance between observation and termination (7160 s); discarded diagnostic foreground scoring 240+120+42 s; first superseded smoke 45.86 s; smoke label probe 73.42 s; remainder rounds conservatively to 8200 s. These allocated-process wall seconds are conservatively charged as GPU seconds, not CUDA active time.
incident.compute_status: ESTIMATE: conservative allocated-process accounting bound, not a measurement of CUDA active seconds
incident.description: The async shell tool reported completion of nohup child launch/wait commands while their scoring children remained alive as PPID 1. A second phase launch and a diagnostic relaunch ran the same frozen shards concurrently. Once the process table established this, eight duplicate workers were terminated and the original four were retained. No arm, lambda, checkpoint, label, contrast, or frozen rule changed and no outcome-dependent model selection was performed.
